captions.detailed: This object is a magnifier-style task lamp designed for bench inspection. It features a heavy, circular, matte black base with a short vertical stem supporting a lower hinge. A slender, dual-link grey metal arm extends upwards via an elbow hinge, leading to a circular magnifier lamp head. The lamp head consists of a light grey ring housing a magnifying lens, complete with a hinged grey lens cover on top that can flip open.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a magnifier task lamp. It should feature a heavy circular base, a dual-link articulating arm connected by revolute joints, and a circular magnifying head at the tip with an integrated hinged lens cover.
captions.factory: The code constructs an articulated assembly starting with a base part comprising a flat cylinder and a small vertical block. It attaches a lower arm link using a revolute joint, modeled with slender cylinders and rectangular connectors. An upper arm link is connected via an elbow revolute joint. The lamp head is built from concentric cylinders (for the casing and lens) and is attached to the upper arm via a tilting revolute joint. Finally, a lens cover is modeled as a flat disc and mounted to the main head with a small offset hinge joint.
